# x402interop

> Open-source cross-chain facilitator, scheme family, and discovery layer for x402. Lets an agent pay on its own chain while the seller is paid on a different chain, using NEAR Intents for settlement. Status: design and early build; API shapes are drafts.

## Overview
- [README](../README.md): problem, solution, payment paths, starting chains
- [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md): components, flows, delivery modes, latency model
- [Project notes](PROJECT_NOTES.md): full research and decisions log

## Specs and APIs
- [Scheme specification](../specs/SCHEME_SPEC.md): x402interop scheme family, payload, verify, settle, refund
- [Facilitator API](../specs/FACILITATOR_API.md): standard x402 endpoints plus /interop extensions
